description: EstimationPy is a Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory Python package for estimating states and parameters of dynamic systems represented through the Functional Mockup Interface. Its documentation describes numerical work with NumPy and SciPy, integration with pandas series and data frames, and model execution through PyFMI and Assimulo. Modelica examples are provided as exported Functional Mock-up Units for examples and tests. Public source and documentation are available on GitHub, free under modified three-clause BSD terms. The package is not tied to a country or observation period: coverage, model detail and time resolution come from the FMU and input measurements. A specific caveat is that imported CSV data and associated pandas series must use UTC. Compatibility with the external FMU execution stack also needs checking, and this review did not run the examples. The package is useful for calibrating building-system simulations and estimating unobserved states from measurements. It complements the catalogue's Modelica Buildings library (model-modelica-buildings-library), while a particular building model must still expose suitable inputs, states and parameters.
